title: Diversity of RLHF Safety Training as a Mitigation: Testing on Open Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether topic diversity in safety training data is a reliable mitigation. If it works, practitioners can improve robustness by simply diversifying datasets. Clear implication for safety practice.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires inducing misalignment (one SFT run), then applying two different safety fine-tuning datasets (narrow vs. diverse). Constructing the two safety datasets requires domain coverage planning. Three total training runs. Moderate difficulty.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three training runs plus dataset construction for two safety conditions. Clear comparison but the dataset construction for the diverse condition requires covering multiple domains. Tight for 30 hours but feasible if datasets are kept small.
